name: agent-profiler
description: Execution profiler for Claude Code: model wait vs tools vs subagents, live, with OTLP export

otlpEndpoint.title: OTLP/HTTP endpoint
otlpEndpoint.description: Base URL of an OTLP/HTTP collector, e.g. http://localhost:4318 (empty: write files only)

outputDir.title: Trace directory
outputDir.description: Where trace files are written, one folder per session (empty: ~/.claude/agent-profiler)

exportCommandText.title: Export prompts, Bash commands and searches
exportCommandText.description: Include turn prompts, Bash command lines and search patterns in exported traces (files and POSTs), with obvious secrets redacted. Off: they stay out; command categories are still exported.
